request.tone: foggy mystery with moderate peril and scariness, no violence, warm resolution
request.note: catalog book read blind; no request exists

pitch.hero: Mira, a girl who missed the last bus and is stranded on a foggy headland by an abandoned lighthouse
pitch.want: to find out who is lighting the pale light in the lighthouse empty since its keeper vanished
pitch.obstacle: hidden passages, rising tide, rotten stairs and rails, and a smuggler waiting offshore
pitch.stake: the missing keeper's fate and name, and her own safety in the dark
pitch.ending_kind: branch and bottleneck: many careful-or-rash setbacks, then several ways to reveal the truth

mira.name: Mira
mira.want: to find out who is lighting the pale light in the empty lighthouse
mira.voice: third person past; brave but nervous, talks to objects and herself with dry humour

ferris.name: R. Ferris
ferris.role: the missing keeper, hiding on the moor and keeping the light blinking
ferris.want: to keep the smuggler off his tower and be found by someone who reads his signal
ferris.voice: small square hand, starts with the weather; an old voice trying not to shake

varley.name: Varley (V), the man with the grey boat
varley.role: smuggler waiting offshore; heard only on the radio
varley.want: the tower, and the light to go steady so he can land
varley.voice: soft, patient man's voice on the radio

harbour_master.name: the harbour master
harbour_master.role: town authority who receives Mira's evidence in several endings

bus_driver.name: the bus driver
bus_driver.role: minor; drives the last and first bus

truth.question: Who is lighting the pale light in the Hollow Lighthouse, and why?
truth.statement: The pale light is the smuggler Varley's own signal rig, a lantern behind a jar of glowing weed with mirrors and a clockwork shutter hidden in the tower: steady means land, blinking means keep off. Keeper Ferris took Varley's money for six winters to look away, refused to give up his tower, and fled to a cottage on the moor a year ago. Every fog night since he has crept back through his own hidden way to set the lamp blinking, so Varley's cargo sits untouched in the store under the tower.

mira_missed_bus.text: Mira missed the last bus home by four minutes.

fog_tonight.text: Thick fog has rolled over the headland tonight.

lighthouse_dark_empty.text: The Hollow Lighthouse has stood dark and empty, with nobody living there, since its keeper vanished.

ferris_keeper.text: Old Ferris was the keeper of the Hollow Lighthouse.

ferris_vanished.text: Ferris vanished a year ago without a word.

pale_light.text: Tonight a pale light blinks on and off in the lighthouse lamp room.

no_phone_signal.text: Mira's phone has no signal out on the headland.

mira_has_phone.text: Mira has her phone with her, which she uses as a torch and a camera.

next_bus_morning.text: The next bus is not until morning.

bus_shelter.text: There is a bus shelter with a bench where Mira could wait for the morning bus.

keepers_cottage.text: The keeper's cottage crouches against the rock beside the tower.

tower_stair.text: A stair spirals up the tower toward the lamp room.

sea_caves.text: Sea caves gape under the cliff below the tower.

old_boathouse.text: An old boathouse leans over the shingle near the tower.

cottage_left_suddenly.text: The keeper's cottage looks as if Ferris stepped out one morning a year ago and never came back.

log_unfinished.text: The keeper's log lies open at its last page, the writing stopping in the middle of a line.

drawer_locked.text: A small locked drawer under the desk holds something small and heavy.

ferris_square_hand.text: Ferris writes in a small square hand.

ferris_weather_first.text: Ferris begins every entry, and his letter, with the weather.

log_light_not_his.text: Ferris wrote that the pale light was up in his tower though he had not lit it and the great lamp was cold.

smuggler_wants_tower.text: The man Ferris dealt with came to want the whole tower, and Ferris quiet.

ferris_refused_tower.text: Ferris refused to give the man his tower, and was afraid.

brass_tower_key.text: There is a short brass key stamped with a tiny tower.

key_square_end.text: The brass tower key has a square end where its teeth should be.

wind_her_slow.text: The brass key comes with the instruction 'Wind her slow'.

mira_has_key.text: Mira is carrying the brass winding key.

mira_has_no_key.text: Mira does not have the brass winding key.

tower_sketch_door.text: A sketch of the tower shows a small hidden door at its foot, marked 'For whoever comes looking, please.'

nobody_came_looking.text: Nobody has come looking at the lighthouse in a year.

pale_light_his.text: The pale light belongs to him, the smuggler, not to Ferris.

code_steady_lands.text: In the pale light's code a steady light means he lands.

code_blinking_keeps_off.text: In the pale light's code a blinking light means he keeps off.

code_sos.text: Three short, three long, three short flashes will bring any keeper on this coast.

mira_knows_code.text: Mira has learned what the lamp's signals mean and how to flash a call for help.

light_means_keep_off_now.text: The light is blinking tonight, so somebody is being told to keep off right now.

photo_keeper_and_v.text: A scorched photo shows the keeper with a younger man in a good coat, marked 'V. and self, the first winter. I should have shut the door.'

mira_has_photo.text: Mira has the scorched photograph in her pocket.

hearth_bundle.text: An oilcloth bundle is hidden in a hollow behind a loose firebrick in the hearth.

sea_draught_kitchen.text: A cold draught smelling of wet stone and the sea comes up through the cottage kitchen.

under_tower_plan.text: Under the tower lie a brick tunnel, a room, a store and a sea gate.

my_way_to_moor.text: A thin line marked 'my way' runs from under the tower up to the moor.

my_way_behind_bracket.text: The 'my way' passage begins behind a lantern bracket at the tunnel mouth.

mira_knows_tunnel_plan.text: Mira has studied a plan of the passages under the tower, including the keeper's own way.

journal_on_stool.text: A battered journal lies open on a stool on the landing at the tower's foot, with no dust on it.

someone_here_tonight.text: Someone else has been in or under the lighthouse tonight.

light_from_below.text: The pale light is not made in the lamp room; it climbs up from somewhere in the tower's foundations.

great_lens.text: The great glass lens of the lighthouse stands unlit in the lamp room.

lamp_clockwork.text: A rusted clockwork weight and chain once turned the great lamp through the night.

hidden_mirror.text: A small new mirror hidden behind the great lens throws the light from below out to sea.

figure_in_shaft.text: Someone moved across the light in the shaft below the lamp room.

light_on_water.text: A small yellow light shows low on the water offshore, where no light should be.

grey_boat_watching.text: A grey boat with one yellow lamp waits offshore while someone aboard watches the tower's light.

lamp_socket_empty.text: The great lamp's clockwork has an empty square socket where a winding key should go.

great_lamp_needs_key.text: The great lamp cannot be wound or lit without its winding key.

pipe_smoke.text: Someone who smokes a pipe has been here very recently.

light_is_signal.text: The light is not a ghost but a signal.

tide_rising.text: The tide is coming in through the sea caves and tunnel.

fresh_bootprints.text: Large fresh bootprints show someone came this way not long ago.

glowing_weed.text: A weed in the tide pools glows the same pale green as the tower light.

someone_collects_weed.text: Someone has been collecting the glowing weed in a jar, not long ago.

light_is_lamp_and_weed.text: The ghost light is made by a lamp shining through a jar of the glowing weed.

tally_forty_three.text: Forty-three fog nights are tallied on the cave arch, the last one freshly scratched.

forty_three_nights.text: The blinking message has been hung in the fog for forty-three nights.

key_tide_badge.text: The key from the pool hangs on a broken chain with a keeper's tide badge, dropped in a hurry.

boathouse_passage.text: A passage runs under the rock from the boathouse floor hatch to the tower.

cargo_landed_v.text: For six winters cargo was landed on fog nights, each load signed with the letter V.

nothing_taken_away.text: None of the landed cargo was ever taken away.

mira_knows_ledger.text: Mira has seen the tallies: cargo landed for six winters and none ever taken away.

journal_is_ferris.text: The journal on the stool is Ferris's own book.

journal_tunnel_sketch.text: Ferris's journal holds a hurried sketch of a tunnel under the tower.

cargo_after_dark.text: Ferris kept a ledger of cargoes landed at the lighthouse after dark.

light_is_lantern_mirrors.text: Ferris found the light is a lantern and mirrors hidden in his own tower, signalling to a boat.

journal_blinking_year.text: Ferris's journal goes on for a year after he vanished, each fog night marked 'Blinking', the last dated today.

keeper_here_tonight.text: The keeper wrote in his journal tonight, so he is alive and was here.

panel_stair.text: A stair behind a hidden panel in the landing wall climbs up into the tower wall.

crates_412.text: Four hundred and twelve crates came in under the tower.

torn_page_store.text: A page torn from the journal left a strip showing brickwork, an arrow and the word 'store'.

ferris_never_looked_store.text: Ferris wrote that the smuggler's store is under his feet and he never once looked in it.

smuggler_named_varley.text: The smuggler V is a man named Varley.

mira_unaware_name.text: Mira does not know the smuggler's name.

ferris_paid_look_away.text: Ferris took the smuggler's money for six winters to look the other way while cargo was landed.

ledger_photos.text: Mira has photographed the ledger and written its totals on her hand.

padlocked_door.text: A low iron-bound door on the landing has a new, bright, oiled padlock.

flagstone_cross.text: A landing flagstone marked with a small cross rocks over a hollow.

shutter_blinks.text: A falling shutter, ticking like clockwork, makes the light go out and come back.

hollow_step.text: The nineteenth step of the winding stair is hollow, with something inside it.

lantern_to_moor.text: Somebody carrying a lantern is walking away from the tower, inland toward the moor.

light_rig.text: The ghost light is a storm lantern behind a jar of glowing green, angled mirrors and a clockwork shutter.

rig_wound_tonight.text: Someone wound the light's clockwork and tended the lantern tonight.

keepers_coat.text: A keeper's storm coat smelling of tonight's pipe smoke hangs in the stair cupboard.

rig_maintained.text: Somebody keeps the light rig mended and running, with spares and oil.

card_gone_not_lost.text: A card in the keeper's coat ends with the line 'Gone, but not lost.'

frayed_rope.text: The knotted rope in the service shaft is rotten and parting.

tunnel_three_ways.text: The brick tunnel under the tower branches to a brass-bound door, a room that smells of tar and an iron sea gate.

bootprints_at_bracket.text: A line of wet bootprints comes out of the dark and stops at the tunnel-mouth lantern bracket.

keeper_room_door.text: The tower-marked doors off the tunnel open into the keeper's own room.

store_crates.text: The room that smells of tar is a store stacked with unmarked crates and barrels.

radio_voice.text: A man's voice on the store radio says he has seen the tower blinking for a year and can wait longer than the old man can walk.

cargo_untouched.text: The stored cargo has sat untouched for a year; the smuggler has not dared fetch it.

side_door_bootprints.text: Fresh bootprints pass the keeper's side door, going on toward a stair.

keeper_left_by_moor.text: The keeper has only just left by his own hidden way, up a stair toward the moor.

moor_cottage.text: A low stone cottage stands on the moor inland of the headland.

keeper_room.text: The keeper's room is small, dry and under a year of dust, with a pipe rack missing one pipe.

lamp_key_hook_empty.text: The hook labelled 'Lamp key' in the keeper's room is empty.

sealed_letter.text: A letter sealed with red wax is addressed 'To whoever followed the light.'

harbour_office.text: The town has a harbour master and a harbour office who would want the evidence.

mira_read_letter.text: Mira broke the seal and read the keeper's letter.

letter_unopened.text: Mira leaves the keeper's letter sealed and unread.

ferris_ran.text: On his last night as keeper Ferris ran from the smuggler.

ferris_returns_blinking.text: Ferris comes back every fog night to set the smuggler's own lamp blinking, so the smuggler dares not land.

mira_first.text: Mira is the first person who saw the light and came toward it.

ferris_on_moor.text: Ferris now lives out on the moor, away from the tower.

harbour_opens_six.text: The harbour office opens at six in the morning.

bog_second_gate.text: A bog lies by the second gate on the path across the moor.

cottage_man_keeps_light.text: The frightened old man in the moor cottage is the one who keeps the pale light.

smuggler_grey_boat.text: The smuggler is the man with the grey boat.

ferris_said_nothing.text: The old man in the cottage has said nothing to anyone for a whole year.

bribe_under_step.text: Unopened envelopes of the smuggler's money, marked V, are hidden under the hollow step of the winding stair.

ferris_initial_r.text: The keeper signs himself R. Ferris.

clockwork_forty_turns.text: The little lamp's clockwork wants forty turns to wind.

ferris_apology.text: Ferris asks that the town be told he is sorry and that the light was never a ghost.

store_drag_marks.text: Drag marks in the store's dust lead toward the far end, deeper in.

hoard_room.text: A hidden second room holds the best of the cargo, skimmed and hoarded by the smuggler.

jewelled_compass.text: A jewelled compass set with green stones sits on black velvet on top of the hoard.

compass_bait_wire.text: The compass is bait, wired to a bell at the sea gate that would call the smuggler in.

hoard_cleared.text: The smuggler cleared the hoard room before first light.

mira_has_photos.text: Mira has photographs of the smuggler's cargo on her phone.

hand_lever.text: A lever on the little lamp switches its shutter from clockwork to hand working.

key_hid_patient.text: Scratched beside the great lamp's socket are the words 'Key hid. Be patient.'

key_hidden_somewhere.text: A key for the great lamp is hidden somewhere about the lighthouse.

socket_wind_slow.text: The words 'Wind her slow' are stamped in the brass around the great lamp's key socket.

great_lamp_lit.text: The great lamp is lit again and its beam turns out to sea.

town_thinks_dead.text: The harbour clerk believes old Ferris has been dead a year.

gently_does_it.text: Under the chimney rubble a stone is chalked 'Gently does it' in small square letters.

dry_way_arrows.text: Arrows scratched along the cave ledge mark the dry way inland for whoever comes after.

light_keeper_fled.text: The padlock alarm sent whoever was keeping the light running, and the light went dark.

older_arrow.text: An old faded chalk arrow by a taller hand already points to the panel at the tower's foot.

coastguard_caught.text: Answering Mira's call, the coastguard caught the smuggler's boat.

search_party.text: People have been out since ten o'clock searching for Mira.

n_open.event: Mira, having missed the last bus, sees a pale light blinking in the long-dark Hollow Lighthouse through the fog.

n_start.event: With no phone signal and no bus till morning, Mira picks one of four ways around the tower.

a_office1.event: Mira enters the cold cottage, untouched for a year, and sees a desk, shelves and a hearth.

a_desk.event: The desk holds the keeper's log open at an unfinished last page and a locked drawer with something heavy inside.

a_desk_log.event: The log says the pale light was not Ferris's doing and a man wanted the whole tower; the entry breaks off.

a_desk_drawer.event: Mira weighs picking the drawer's lock slowly with a letter-opener against wrenching it by the handle.

a_desk_pick.event: The lock gives and Mira pockets a square-ended brass key stamped with a tower and tagged 'Wind her slow'.

a_shelf.event: Among ships in bottles Mira spots one with paper in its hull and a much-handled logbook.

a_shelf_bottle.event: The paper in the bottle is a sketch of the tower with a hidden door at its foot, left for whoever comes looking.

a_shelf_books.event: The worn logbook lists the pale light's code: steady he lands, blinking he keeps off, and the call that brings any keeper.

a_hearth.event: Mira finds something square in the ash and a crooked firebrick above it.

a_hearth_ash.event: The square thing is a half-burnt photo of the keeper with a man called V, noting 'I should have shut the door'.

a_hearth_brick.event: Behind the loose brick sits an oilcloth bundle, but the brick jams and the chimney shifts.

a_hearth_key.event: Mira eases out the bundle: a square-ended brass tower key tagged 'Wind her slow', hidden for someone careful.

a_corridor.event: In the dark hall Mira chooses between the tower door and a sea-smelling draught from the kitchen.

a_kitchen.event: Pencilled above a crack in the pantry is a plan of the tunnel, room, store, sea gate and the keeper's 'my way' to the moor.

a_toward.event: On the landing at the tower's foot Mira finds a dust-free journal on a stool, recently handled.

b_lamp1.event: In the lamp room the pale light gives no heat and seems to rise from the floor; Mira sees the lens, gallery and clockwork weight.

b_lens.event: Light rises through a cracked panel; a new hidden mirror sits behind the lens with a bundle hung behind it.

b_lens_crack.event: Down the shaft Mira sees a shoulder pass across the light, then makes herself take the stair down.

b_lens_reflect.event: The mirror throws light from below out to sea; Mira pockets the brass tower key tagged 'Wind her slow' from behind it.

b_gallery.event: On the rusty gallery Mira glimpses something wink low on the water.

b_gallery_out.event: On the walk Mira sees a small yellow spark low on the water, just beyond the rail.

b_gallery_edge.event: Edging round, Mira sees a long grey boat with a yellow lamp, someone in its bow watching each blink of the light.

b_gallery_fog.event: Through the window Mira sees a green glow blinking from a grille at the tower's foot: the light starts below.

b_clock.event: The great lamp's clockwork has an empty square key socket; its chain runs down a shaft beside a keepers' stair.

b_clock_wind.event: Hauling the chain only makes noise, since the lamp wants its key; footsteps and a closing door sound far below.

b_clock_chain.event: Pencilled under old painted signals, the code reads steady he lands, blinking he keeps off, plus the keeper's call.

b_down.event: At a split between the spiral stair and a service hatch Mira smells fresh pipe smoke.

b_down_spiral.event: Ninety-one steps down, Mira finds a dust-free journal on a stool on the landing at the tower's foot.

b_down_hatch.event: Climbing down the hatch Mira learns a pencilled plan of the tunnels and 'my way', then finds the dust-free journal.

c_cave1.event: In the breathing sea caves Mira sees an inland passage with the sea on its floor, glimmering pools and a marked arch.

c_pass.event: The narrowing passage floods higher with each wave; a ledge climbs one wall while the floor runs flat and wet.

c_pass_deep.event: Along the ledge Mira escapes the tide and finds cut steps with a fresh large bootprint.

c_pool.event: The pools hold weed glowing the tower light's green, a brass gleam in the sand and a collector's jar.

c_pool_glow.event: Holding the weed to her phone, Mira works out the ghost light is a lamp behind a jar of it.

c_pool_metal.event: Mira fishes out a square-ended brass tower key on a keeper's tide badge, dropped in a hurry, and pockets it.

c_arch.event: The arch is covered in tally marks and cramped writing; a cold narrow gap leads on.

c_arch_marks.event: Mira counts forty-three fog-night tallies, the last fresh, and reads the light's code beneath them.

c_arch_gap.event: Wedged in the gap, Mira hears a slow clock-like sound and feels another opening behind her.

c_gather.event: In a dry chamber under the tower Mira finds steps, a ladder past a brass plate and a still-smoky burnt match.

c_steps.event: Huge wet bootprints lead up the steps to the landing and stop at the dust-free journal on its stool.

c_ladder.event: Halfway up the ladder Mira learns a pencilled plan of the tunnels and 'my way', then finds the dust-free journal.

d_boat1.event: In the creaking boathouse Mira can search a tarped dinghy, a tool locker or a loft up a broken ladder.

d_dinghy.event: Dry oilskins smelling of pipe smoke, a rolled chart and a clinking bailing tin lie in the unused dinghy.

d_dinghy_tarp.event: The chart maps a passage from the boathouse to the tower, the tunnel, room, store, sea gate and 'my way' to the moor.

d_dinghy_tin.event: The tin holds the brass tower key and a note: the light is a signal, come further, and wind her slow.

d_locker.event: The locker holds strong rope, a half-full storm lantern with matches and a wall of faint chalk.

d_locker_rope.event: Mira ties a guide rope back to the door and finds a worn floor hatch under old net.

d_locker_lantern.event: By lantern light the chalk is a six-winter tally of fog-night cargo signed V, with nothing ever taken away.

d_loft.event: A cracked rung guards the loft, where a sheet of dots and lines is pinned to a beam.

d_loft_up.event: In the loft a lamp-signal chart carries the pencilled code: steady he lands, blinking he keeps off, and the keeper's call.

d_hatch.event: The floor hatch sticks while the banging door shakes a shelf of heavy gear above it.

d_hatch_down.event: Under the hatch a passage smelling of pipe smoke runs to the tower and a landing with the dust-free journal.

n_journal.event: The journal is Ferris's own: pages on the pale light, a ledger of night cargoes and a tunnel sketch; a board creaks above.

jr_light.event: Ferris's uneasy entries say the light was not his; one page explains its shining, another lists dozens of dates.

jr_light_read.event: Ferris wrote that the light is a lantern and mirrors signalling a boat, set out the code, and said to take the stair behind the panel.

jr_light_date.event: The dates log six winters of cargo signed V, none taken away, then a year of 'Blinking' nights in the keeper's hand up to tonight.

jr_light_join.event: Mira finds the hollow panel, which swings open on oiled hinges onto a cramped stair into the wall, as he said.

jr_smug.event: The ledger shows six winters of fog-night cargo signed V and nothing taken away; V is sometimes written in code as a name.

jr_smug_ledger.event: The figures total 412 crates in and none out, and a torn-out page left a strip marked 'store'.

jr_smug_copy.event: Mira photographs the ledger, writes the totals on her hand, and reads a line pointing to the stair behind the panel.

jr_smug_torn.event: The torn page shows the store Ferris never looked in, the full plan under the tower, and the stair behind the panel.

jr_smug_names.event: Decoding the name, Mira learns V is Varley, who paid Ferris to look away and now wants his tower; Ferris refused and is afraid.

jr_smug_join.event: Mira opens the panel onto a stair but also sees a low door with a new, oiled padlock.

jr_tunnel.event: The tunnel sketch marks a cross 'under the stone', matching a rocking flagstone by the stool.

jr_tun_sketch.event: The sketch shows the tunnel to the keeper's room, the smuggler's store and the sea gate, 'my way' from a lantern bracket, and the panel stair.

jr_tun_stone.event: Under the flagstone a slate holds the light's code; the hollow goes on down and the sketch lies on the stool.

jr_tun_heave.event: Heaving the flagstone over shows a flooded shaft; footsteps sound inside the wall above and the wall behind her moves.

jr_tun_join.event: A panel swings open onto a cramped stair carrying ticking, green flicker and faint pipe smoke.

n_stairs.event: The stair splits into a tight inner stair and outer steps in the fog; a falling shutter makes the light go out.

st_wind.event: On the winding stair the nineteenth step is hollow and something slides inside it.

st_wind_up.event: Stepping over the hollow step, Mira climbs to a warm frosted door pulsing green.

st_outer.event: On the slick outer steps a gust pins Mira to the wall; a door bangs somewhere below.

st_outer_wait.event: When the wind drops Mira sees a lantern carried away from the tower up toward the moor.

st_outer_up.event: Mira reaches the warm, green-pulsing frosted door at the top of the outer steps.

n_light.event: Behind the door the ghost is a storm lantern, a glowing jar, mirrors and a clockwork shutter, wound and filled tonight.

li_stair.event: On the stone stair a cupboard holds wire, a box and a coat, with warm pipe ash in a saucer.

li_stair_down.event: Mira descends quietly past the rig to a sweating undercroft and a breathing brick tunnel mouth.

li_stair_cup.event: The cupboard holds a spare lens and a keeper's storm coat smelling of tonight's pipe smoke.

li_cup_lens.event: The spare lens matches the rig's mirrors, so someone keeps the light mended and running.

li_cup_coat.event: A card in the coat says the keeper's way home is behind the tunnel-mouth lantern bracket: 'Gone, but not lost.'

li_shaft.event: The service shaft offers cold iron staples or a creaking knotted rope.

li_shaft_down.event: Mira climbs down the staples to the undercroft and the brick tunnel mouth.

li_shaft_rope.event: The rope holds Mira's weight but a strand parts under her hands.

li_rope_staples.event: Moments after Mira switches to the staples the rope snaps and falls; she reaches the tunnel mouth.

li_ladder.event: The outer ladder is slick and endless in the fog.

li_ladder_down.event: Going three-on-one-off, Mira reaches the rock and a low opening to the tunnel mouth.

n_tunnel.event: Lighting a still-warm lantern, Mira sees branches to a brass-bound door, a tar-smelling room and a sea gate; wet bootprints stop at the bracket.

tn_keeper.event: The tower-marked oak door has a huge lock and its rusted key on a hook; a fallen beam blocks a side passage.

tn_keep_door.event: The rusted key turns half way and seizes; oil and time, or one hard shove.

tn_keep_open.event: The lock gives and the door, shut a year, opens on stale air; Mira steps into the keeper's room.

tn_keep_stuck.event: Shoving jams the key fast, with something thin bending inside the lock.

tn_keep_ease.event: Easing the key back straightens the bent ward and the keeper's room door opens.

tn_keep_beam.event: The beam blocks a passage round the keeper's room to a second door; an iron bar leans nearby.

tn_keep_side.event: Levering the beam aside, Mira finds a latched side door and fresh bootprints passing on toward a stair.

tn_store.event: The tar room is a store of unmarked crates; a radio voice says he has watched a year of blinking and can wait.

tn_store_crate.event: A crate holds year-old cloth, tobacco and bottles, untouched: the smuggler cannot come and fetch his shop.

tn_store_box.event: The ledger box shows six winters of cargo signed V, none taken away, and a blank last year.

tn_store_join.event: In the passage beyond, a draught shrinks the lantern flame as a paler door shape shows ahead.

tn_store_relight.event: Trimming the wick reveals chalk tallies, cargo landed with V and none taken away, before a tower-marked door.

tn_gate.event: At the sea gate the tide climbs the slipway and a yellow light hangs perfectly still offshore.

tn_gate_open.event: Mira slips through the gate onto the wet ledge and times the swells.

tn_gate_wait.event: Waiting out the big swells, Mira reads chalk tallies of cargo landed with V and none taken away, then reaches a door.

tn_cut.event: Behind the painted bracket a hidden passage forks to the keeper's back door and a stair to the moor with fresh wet bootprints.

tn_cut_moor.event: Mira follows the bootprints over the moor at dawn to a low stone cottage with smoke rising.

n_chamber.event: In the dusty keeper's room Mira finds an empty 'Lamp key' hook and a sealed letter 'To whoever followed the light'.

cm_letter.event: Mira hesitates between breaking the tower seal and keeping the letter whole for the harbour master.

cm_letter_read.event: Ferris's letter confesses six winters of bribes, his flight, and his nightly return to set the smuggler's lamp blinking.

cm_letter_map.event: The map leads over the moor past a bog to Ferris's shepherd's cottage; the harbour office opens at six.

cm_cottage.event: A frightened old voice behind the blue door asks if the man with the grey boat sent her and how she found his light.

cm_cottage_bus.event: Mira explains she missed the bus; the old man laughs for the first time in a year and unbolts the door.

cm_cottage_light.event: Mira tells him the light says keep off; he says she is the only one in forty-three nights to read it, and unbolts.

cm_cottage_wait.event: Mira tells him to stay bolted while she fetches the harbour office; he names himself Ferris and warns her of the bog.

cm_letter_conf.event: R. Ferris's signed confession admits taking Varley's money for six winters and hiding it unspent under the hollow step.

cm_letter_plea.event: Ferris asks Mira to tell the town he is sorry and to wind the clockwork forty turns if the light ever stops blinking.

cm_letter_keep.event: Mira leaves the seal unbroken and buttons the letter into her coat.

cm_smug.event: Back in the vast dusty store a radio voice says 'Still blinking... I can wait'; drag marks lead deeper.

cm_smug_photo.event: Mira takes forty-one photos, but with no signal they wait while the man offshore waits for the light to change.

cm_smug_follow.event: The drag marks lead to a hidden hoard skimmed by the man with the grey boat, topped by a jewelled compass.

cm_smug_hoard.event: Hands in her pockets, Mira photographs the whole hoard untouched: sixty-three pictures.

cm_smug_token.event: Mira is tempted to pocket the jewelled compass as proof for the harbour master.

cm_light.event: Back at the rig Mira sees how the lantern, weed jar and clockwork borrow the tower, under a great lamp dark for a year.

cm_light_relight.event: The great lamp has oil and wick but its clockwork socket is empty; the big gear barely gives by hand.

cm_light_back.event: Mira finds 'Key hid. Be patient.' scratched by the socket and realises she walked past the tower key somewhere.

cm_light_true.event: Mira winds the great lamp's clockwork forty turns with the brass key, slowly as the tag said, and lights it.

cm_light_study.event: Mira studies the shutter and finds a clock-or-hand lever that would let her flash a message herself.

cm_leave.event: Exhausted, Mira means to leave the stair, ghost and room behind; there is chalk on the desk and the journal is under her arm.

cm_leave_town.event: Mira leaves the letter on the desk and heads for the bus shelter, looking back at the blinking lantern.

cm_leave_mark.event: Mira chalks her first arrow and must decide whether to leave the journal open on the desk or carry it out.

e_set_a_drawer.event: The drawer splits and jams; Mira can see the tower key but never reach it, and dawn puts out the light.

e_set_a_brick.event: The chimney collapses over the hollow; near dawn Mira digs down to a stone chalked 'Gently does it'.

e_set_b_rail.event: The rotten rail tears away; shaken, Mira watches a yellow lamp at sea dip each time the tower blinks.

e_set_c_tide.event: The tide traps Mira on the ledge for hours, but the glowing weed lights arrows marking the dry way.

e_set_c_stuck.event: Stuck in the gap, Mira hears clockwork ticking in the rock, wound since sundown.

e_set_d_loft.event: The rung snaps; flat on her back Mira reads 'Steady, he lands. Blinking, he keeps off' chalked under the loft.

e_set_d_storm.event: The gear crashes over the hatch; Mira hears an old man below say 'Forty-three nights' before he hurries off.

e_set_cellar.event: Rattling the padlock rings an alarm bell; the light's keeper flees, the light goes out and the tower stays dark.

e_set_stair.event: The hollow step breaks under Mira; she finds unopened envelopes of banknotes marked V and a swelling ankle.

e_set_shaft.event: The rope snaps; skinned and stranded up top, Mira finds an oil can by the rig dated within the day.

e_set_fog.event: Slipping on the ladder, Mira climbs back up and sees a lantern walking inland across the moor.

e_set_door.event: The key snaps in the lock; through the hinge gap Mira sees the letter 'To whoever followed the light' out of reach.

e_set_beam.event: Pinned by the beam, Mira wriggles out of her jacket and sees large bootprints made within the hour.

e_set_gate.event: A swell throws Mira against the gate, but she glimpses a grey launch whose man watches the tower light.

e_set_token.event: Pocketing the compass trips a wire bell; an engine starts and by first light the hoard room is bare.

e_set_gears.event: Forcing the gear breaks the clockwork; 'Wind her slow' inside shows it wanted a square-ended key, somewhere in the lighthouse.

e_win_keeper_found.event: The old keeper opens his door and tells Mira the whole story, then walks with her to the harbour office.

e_win_keeper_word.event: Mira tells the doubting harbour clerk Ferris is alive on the moor; men bring the old man down by noon.

e_win_name_cleared.event: The harbour master reads the confession; Varley faces questions and the town learns Ferris kept the light.

e_win_promise.event: Mira winds the clockwork forty turns, signs the keeper's journal, and later keeps the light beside him.

e_win_smugglers.event: Mira flashes the keeper's call by hand; the coastguard answers and traps the smuggler's boat.

e_win_harbor.event: The harbour master sees Mira's forty-one photos and the revenue men tow in the grey launch.

e_win_hoard.event: Mira's untouched photographs match the hoard exactly, and the compass proves to be wired bait.

e_win_ledger.event: The crates match the tallies under a year of dust, convincing the harbour master someone kept the smuggler off.

e_win_light_restored.event: The great beam sweeps the sea, the smuggler's launch flees, and the old keeper sets out for the tower.

e_win_rescue.event: Mira flashes the call by hand and the search party out looking for her answers along the coast.

e_win_signal.event: Mira draws the whole rig in her notebook and finds its spring wound tight a few hours ago.

e_neutral_letter.event: Mira hands the sealed letter to the harbour master, who gives it back to her to open with him as witness.

e_neutral_honest.event: Photographing the compass untouched, Mira finds the wire to a bell: bait set by the man with the grey boat.

e_neutral_town.event: Mira sleeps in the bus shelter, rides home with the same driver, and sees the pale light blink once more.

e_neutral_evidence.event: Mira leaves the journal open at the tunnel sketch and chalks her way out, beside an old arrow by a taller hand.

e_neutral_museum.event: Carrying the journal out, Mira sees a year of 'Blinking' dates up to today and runs for the harbour office.

payoff_sites.shows: With the key, Mira can wind and relight the great lamp.
Without the key, Mira can only leave the dark lamp and go back down.
Knowing the code, Mira tells the keeper his light says keep off.
Without the code, Mira can only tell the keeper she missed the bus.
Knowing the call, Mira can flash for the coastguard from the store.
Knowing the call, Mira can flash for help with the shutter by hand.
Knowing the plan, Mira can open the keeper's hidden way behind the bracket.
Knowing the tallies, Mira can count the crates and prove none ever left.

e_set_a_drawer.gift: the tower key glimpsed through the split, and the lesson to be patient with locks

e_set_a_brick.gift: a sooty laugh and the keeper's chalked advice: gently does it

e_set_b_rail.gift: a close escape and the sight of a lamp at sea nodding to the tower's blinks

e_set_c_tide.gift: the flooded cave lit green, and arrows showing someone marked the dry way

e_set_c_stuck.gift: the clue that clockwork in the rock was wound since sundown

e_set_d_loft.gift: half of the light's code, chalked to be read from flat on her back

e_set_d_storm.gift: an old man's voice counting forty-three nights: the keeper is near and alive

e_set_cellar.gift: proof the light's keeper is real and frightened, and a reason to come back gentler

e_set_stair.gift: the keeper's unopened bribe money, never spent

e_set_shaft.gift: an oil can dated today: somebody tends the ghost light

e_set_fog.gift: a lantern walking inland: whoever lit the light is going home to bed

e_set_door.gift: the letter for whoever followed the light, seen but out of reach

e_set_beam.gift: bootprints within the hour: someone uses the side passage

e_set_gate.gift: a clear sight of the grey launch watching the light like a red signal

e_set_token.gift: the hard lesson that the compass was bait, and the hoard lost

e_set_gears.gift: the stamped words 'Wind her slow': a square-ended key is still out there

e_win_keeper_found.gift: the keeper found alive, his story told, and a walk to the harbour together

e_win_keeper_word.gift: the keeper brought home safe, and his dry thanks for minding the bog

e_win_name_cleared.gift: the keeper's name cleared and Varley called to answer

e_win_promise.gift: a keeper's promise kept: Mira shares the light with the old man

e_win_smugglers.gift: the smugglers caught by her signal, and the coastguard calling her keeper

e_win_harbor.gift: the smuggler's launch towed in on her photos, and a bacon sandwich

e_win_hoard.gift: the hoard proven untouched, and the bait wire found by the revenue men

e_win_ledger.gift: the count that proves someone kept the smuggler off for a year

e_win_light_restored.gift: the great lamp lit again, the smuggler fled, the keeper coming home

e_win_rescue.gift: the light saying come for the first time, and the searchers finding her

e_win_signal.gift: the ghost solved on paper, and the one clue she cannot draw

e_neutral_letter.gift: the letter returned to her, to open with the harbour master as witness

e_neutral_honest.gift: clean hands and the bait wire spotted in time

e_neutral_town.gift: a ride home and one last blink from the tower

e_neutral_evidence.gift: her chalk arrow beside an older one: someone hoped to be followed before

e_neutral_museum.gift: the journal's proof the keeper was here today, and a run for the harbour
